subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Deception
solution:
The correct answer is **"Cunning"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here lets see what the given words refer to:

__
 
• **Deception -** making somebody believe or being made to believe something that is not true(कपट, धोखा)

 
 
• **Example:** He had obtained the secret papers by* deception*.
 
 
 
• **Cunning - **clever in a dishonest or bad way(चतुर, शातिर)
 
 
• ​Example: He was as *cunning *as a fox.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here we will see the other words with the help of examples:

 
• **Cruelty -** cruel behaviour(क्रूरता, निर्दयता)

 
 
• ​Example: Keeping a dog tied up outside all day and all night is animal *cruelty*.
 
 
 
• **Reliability -** the probability that a product, system, or service will perform its intended function adequately for a specified period of time, or will operate in a defined environment without failure(विश्वसनीयता) 
 
 
• ​Example: If you measure a cup of rice three times, and you get the same result each time, that result is *reliable. *
 
 
 
• **Exception -** a person or thing that is not included in a general statement(अपवाद)
 
 
• Example:Everybody was poor as a student and I was no *exception.*
